PayFlow design directions

Premium, calm, powerful money. Pick A or B; ⭐ marks my recommendation. Press the buttons and tap any amount to feel the motion. Self-contained: works offline.

A. Aurum Noir⭐ Recommended

A private bank after hours. Layered graphite, one champagne accent that catches light like brushed metal, fine film grain, and large serif numerals that make every rupee feel considered.

Shape and texture

Radii 12 / 20 / 28. Depth from layered tones and a 1dp inner hairline, not drop shadows. Metallic sheen on the hero card and primary button; 3% film grain on dark surfaces.

Motion personality

Calm and weighted. Snappy 1200/1.0, Bouncy 420/0.72, Gentle 160/0.95. Press 90ms, small 240ms, screen 420ms, stagger 40ms.

5 signature moments

  • Sheen sweep across the hero amount when it updates
  • Swipe-to-pay with ticks along a brushed-metal track
  • Checkmark drawn in champagne, then a receipt prints with a perforated edge
  • Scan & Pay ring breathes, then container-transforms into the viewfinder
  • Biometric success opens the app with a circular reveal

B. Ion Glass

A precise instrument. Cool blue-black, frosted glass panels floating over a slow aurora, and one electric ion-lime accent. Sharper and faster than A, more tech than private bank.

Shape and texture

Radii 10 / 16 / 24. Depth from glass blur (Haze, API 31+, dim scrim below) and 1dp light borders. Animated gradient noise behind the hero card; no grain.

Motion personality

Crisp and quick. Snappy 1500/1.0, Bouncy 520/0.62, Gentle 220/0.9. Press 90ms, small 200ms, screen 360ms, stagger 30ms.

5 signature moments

  • Aurora drifts behind the hero card, responding to scroll
  • Swipe-to-pay trail glows ion-lime and snaps with a spring
  • Scan beam shader with brackets that lock onto the QR
  • Success ring pulses outward through the glass layers
  • Glass bottom bar with a sliding pill and morphing icons
